auto.text: A six-ball routine that the team says runs with the Limelight taken off, on paths followed by wheel odometry.
A post speaking for the team credits a week 2 six-ball auto for a #1 autonomous OPR.

cycle.text: The intake takes in and holds up to two balls, which go up a two-stage elevator. The operator turns the turret toward the goal and the camera takes over once locked. A wrong-color ball turns the turret about 10 degrees, drops speed and hood, and is thrown away.

endgame.text: A middle arm latches the mid bar and other arms hold it; the robot tilts nearly horizontal and swings to the next bar, with each step triggered by gyro angle. Times given: high two to three seconds, traversal nine to ten.
A commenter says traversal was used only once through the district championship, as it had not been necessary.

fallback.text: If the Limelight fails, drive the bumpers up against the goal and shoot from there.

gave_up.text: The traversal swing toward the alliance station is, the team says, really violent.
A commenter judged traversal not worth the falling risk and lost scoring time.
A recap video says overnight humidity at the championship swelled the wood and hurt performance, and a makeshift dehumidifier took out a pound of water.

changed.text: After the first event the flimsy intake got bracing and extra wood pieces.
Aiming the turret by odometry was dropped for teleop because it drifted with defense, contact and slip.
The robot fell from the traversal at its first competition; the team says nothing important broke.

outcome.text: 62-7-0 in official play; ranked 16 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 57.72, Galileo).

solves.text: Protect the modules and keep a tall robot from tipping

facts.text: Swerve Drive Specialties inverted modules, captioned "mark iv"
The team says 11 motors sit within about 4 in of the bottom
A post speaking for the team calls it the team's first in-season swerve robot

solves.text: Take in anything in front of the robot, from the corners in

cost.text: At first it was flimsy; bracing was added after the first event

facts.text: When it drops it rides along the robot's own bumpers
Parts on it pull the ball to the center, with Velcro on the sides and on the bottom and top rollers
Can take two balls at a time
A NEO 550 on a VersaPlanetary drove it through laser-cut aluminum gears on a shaft

solves.text: Throw away a wrong-color ball and give the shooter time to recover

facts.text: A color sensor is in the upper stage
On a wrong color the turret turns about 10 degrees while shooter speed and hood drop
The elevator lowers and raises the next ball so the shooter has time to recover
The intake section holds two balls so a third cannot enter; for one competition the team wanted to carry and shoot three, with a ball pulled into the upper stage

solves.text: Shoot at once from practically anywhere on the field

facts.text: Runs at about 2000 to 2900 rpm, so it does not wait to spin up for range
The team calls both the shooter and the turret its fifth generation
Backspin was added for 2022
The team's sweet spot is the ring around the tarmac

functions.name: Climber

solves.text: Use the momentum of the swing to reach the next bar

cost.text: The traversal swing is really violent: fully extended, the robot acts as a pendulum toward the alliance station

functions.type: center arm plus pivoted arms, swing driven

facts.text: Steps are triggered by gyro angle, with no timers
Mid climb about one second by the team's account

The first climber is aluminum tubing raised by a constant force spring and lowered through a ratchet; the second climbers are little arms pivoted by a Falcon, a VersaPlanetary and laser-cut aluminum gears

solves.text: Follow drawn autonomous paths and turn while moving

cost.text: Drifts over a match from defense, hitting walls or robots and carpet slip

facts.text: Tuned over about two months on the previous year's swerve robot
Relied on mainly in the first 15 seconds

solves.text: Stay adaptable and durable through a season

cost.text: A recap video says humidity at the championship swelled the wood and hurt performance

facts.text: Support blocks can be added with wood glue and screws
The team says it did no prototyping and spent much of its time in CAD
A post speaking for the team gives a 7-week design and a 6-day build
The robot used no pneumatics

decisions.because: the team finds wood highly adaptable and very durable, and has always built with it
the team expected robots to be run over a lot and wanted the modules protected and the weight down low

decisions.choice: Gyro angle to time the climb
decisions.because: a timer can be thrown off by the swing or by a robot hitting it

decisions.choice: Operator and camera aim the turret in teleop
decisions.because: odometry aiming drifted too much over a match
